proposals.evidence: Turner gives Assamese munih man/hired farmworker and Bengali munis labourer in the manuṣya family influenced by puruṣa. Bishnupriya munī is compared with this directly neighbouring munih form; the final h loss and mixed historical family make this a qualified regional comparison.
